[PATH:empirical] Longitudinal survey study of remote workers in urban/suburban areas, collecting self-reported workspace characteristics (e.g., noise level, presence of dedicated room) and objective productivity metrics (e.g., output per hour from work logs) over several months. — Captures real-world variability in workspace conditions and productivity across the target geographic and temporal scope, enabling correlational analysis to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
